name: Industrial Production (IIP)
description: The Index of Industrial Production (base 2022-23) tracks output across mining, manufacturing and electricity. It is the most timely official read on the factory economy, released well before quarterly GDP.
source: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
releaseSchedule: Released monthly, around the 28th of the following month. The latest month is a quick estimate and is revised later.

chart.title: Industrial output grew 8% in August
chart.subtitle: IIP, year-on-year %. July is revised; August is a quick estimate.
